nodes.label: Case Detail Modal - Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp.
nodes.description: UI screenshot of a case/matter detail modal dialog. Displays a case for 'Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp.' categorized as 'Business / Contract'. Shows a multi-step status workflow with stages: Invited, New, In review (currently active/selected), Consult scheduled, Conflict hold, Engaged, Declined, Closed. Contains a 'Client answers' section with a 'Generate brief' primary action button and a 'Delete' secondary button. The modal has a close (x) button in the top right corner.
